about: Hand-written expectations for #55 (tests/test_issue55_path_list.py and tools/qualify_path_list.py) over tests/fixtures/variants/variants.csv. A path is a pair of labelled activities directly following each other in the declared order (records without a label passed over); incidents are those with the pair, passages its occurrences, the lag the median of the hours from the first record to the second. V-U1 has no known order and is on no path. Flows: incidents beginning or ending with an activity at a labelled record. Never read by product code.
